description: One page of recent token creations (launches). Optional singular `source` (e.g. "pump_fun") — NOT an array; live multi-source use tail_stream with `sources`. Use excludeMayhem=true to drop mayhem-mode launches. To get more, call again with `cursor` set to the previous `next`; stop when `next` is null.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response's `next` for the next page

limit.description: Rows per page; default 20 to conserve context — raise only if needed

name: list_creations
